Today in adventures of being married:

No, not an offer (and I’m sorry if you got excited for a second there 😆). I got helpful advice. A really big piece of advice that will help shape all of my future queries and likely the rest of my writing career.

I was in the middle of earning a certificate from a special arts program that my high school offered making it so that I could take 3 arts classes a year (drama each semester and vocal music every other) instead of one, when I suddenly couldn’t step foot on stage anymore.

My high school closed down for good today. The last graduating class ever had a drive-thru graduation. High school was the worst period of my entire life. I suffered with really bad anxiety and depression that got almost unmanageable after 9/11, and my friends didn’t understand.

I wanted to quit. I tried to drop out but when I went to get the paper signed, my drama teacher convinced me not to. He told me I had an eye for dramatic arts and that he believed I could contribute to the class even if I couldn’t be on stage. He made me stage manager.

You can’t see “my seat”—it was in the middle section, second row on the far end—but my teacher and this room probably saved my life. It definitely got me through high school and made me who I am today.
